summary: TSMC filed a Form 6-K reporting routine board resolutions: Q1 2026 financial results, declaration of a NT$7.0 per share cash dividend (record date Sep 22, 2026, ex-div Sep 16, 2026, payable Oct 8, 2026), capital appropriations of ~US$31.3B for capacity expansion, a capital injection of up to US$20B into wholly-owned subsidiary TSMC Arizona, and routine promotions of executives. This is a standard quarterly update with no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation event. The filing contains ordinary-course financial and operational approvals, not a special situation.
